Two selected nodes sharing one unselected curve handle are kept; select the handle too or align the nodes separately. Components move through outline_transform without changing their base glyphs. Anchors are never moved. Distribution requires selected nodes and is disabled for All nodes. Locked layers/shapes, shared outlines, contours with their own transform and invalid position calculations produce labelled kept rows while other eligible items remain editable. Selection is captured once per scan and again for Apply. Bounds include selected control points; coordinates are upright and italic angle is not applied. Automatic-layer glyphs and their bases are skipped.

title: Rotate Selection
scope: Signed rotation of selected own nodes and selected components about combined coordinate bounds. Six one-click presets apply 1, 10 or 45 degrees CW/CCW. Adds a preview and processes several masters or selected layers together compared with native Rotate commands and the Transform panel. Each action is recorded as one Undo step.

title: Reflect Horizontally
scope: Horizontal reflection of selected own nodes and selected component placements about combined coordinate bounds. Adds a preview and processes several masters or selected layers together compared with Tools > Flip Horizontal. Each action is recorded as one Undo step.

title: Reflect Vertically
scope: Vertical reflection of selected own nodes and selected component placements about combined coordinate bounds. Adds a preview and processes several masters or selected layers together compared with Tools > Flip Vertical. Each action is recorded as one Undo step.

title: Overlap Nodes
copyright: 2020 Alex Slobzheninov; italic-coordinate idea credited to Rainer Erich Scheichelbauer
scope: Move the first eligible adjacent corner onto each selected tip, make it sharp and align its next handle using that layer's associated master italic angle. Auxiliary layers resolve by FontLab master naming rules; layers without an associated master are refused. Handle x is truncated in glyph space. Conflicting targets and scaled or rotated selected shapes are refused. Selected-layer or all-master scope includes a preview. Each action is recorded as one Undo step.

title: Selection Layer Navigator
scope: Also covers App/Next Layer in Selection.py, Previous Layer in Selection.py, Toggle Axis 1.py through Toggle Axis 4.py and Toggle Italic.py. Non-modal Previous/Next navigator. Layer order skips locked layers and synchronizes selected Glyph-window slots by the first usable reference's target name. Unusable references produce named kept rows while later slots continue. Axis mode cycles complete native locations with other coordinates fixed; Font-window mode cycles the current font master. Explicit slots stay explicit; default-follow slots continue to follow the glyph's active layer. Editor navigation retains the package master. No geometry or history notifications.

title: Delete Kerning Pair From All Masters
destination: Scripts/Kerning/Delete Kerning Pair From All Masters.py
source_path: Kerning/Delete Kerning Pair From All Masters.py
scope: Delete existing side-group or fallback glyph records for consecutive selected-or-active master-layer slots across every master. Preserve and list overriding exceptions. Report actual removed records and no-op separately. Use the shared typed kerning batch writer.

title: Kern To Max
scope: Set typed class or fallback glyph kerning to minus truncated half of the narrower advance. Require exactly two consecutive selected-or-active slots on the same declared master. Reject invalid widths and ambiguous groups. List overriding exceptions and report unchanged values distinctly.

title: Steal Kerning From Next Pair
source_path: Kerning/Steal Kerning From Next Pair at Cursor's Y.py
scope: Non-modal four-slot gap matching with height defaulting to half the shown master's x-height. Read transformed component contours, elevate quadratics and use shared twelve-step curve flattening. Include vertices and flat edges at the measuring height. Skip open contours and list notices by glyph name. Preserve target exception identities; show the target Record in the preview. A computed zero removes that record. Remeasure and reject stale inputs before one shared kerning write. Curve measurements are approximate.

title: Generate Random Alternates Feature
scope: Non-modal seeded contextual-feature generator with side-by-side existing and generated source, Copy feature and Write feature. Differing existing code requires the unchecked-by-default Replace existing feature checkbox. Append and identical blocks need no consent. Input changes, refreshed previews, stale-source refusals and successful writes reset consent. Use the source-bound feature_blocks writer with every emitted glyph reference; preserve prefix and unrelated features. Compile in the Features panel. Unicode category filtering replaces Glyphs categories; export flags are not used. Class and lookup names include tag and seed.

title: Reorder Shapes
scope: Compute one shape-index permutation per glyph from the current master or first declared master present. Apply it only to foreground layers with matching ordered component-base and contour-node-count signatures. Preserve shape groups and internal contour order. Skip and list automatic owners, bases of auto composites, glyphs with locked layers and mismatched layers. Use per-glyph scan budgets. Call layer.changed after reorderShapes and commit eligible changes together with readback.

title: Show All Layers
scope: Open exact foreground glyph/layer symbols for every selected-or-active occurrence in one new proof row. Include masters and auxiliary layers; preserve repeated occurrences; omit mask and service layers. Give each glyph its own scan budget and scale the tab population allowance with occurrence count. No font-data writer.

title: Start From Scratch
copyright: 2017 in LICENSE.txt; 2018–2022 in README.md, Pedro Arilla
scope: Non-modal cleanup checklist with required Preview and default-No confirmation naming the font, glyph count, layer count and chosen data. Includes stickers. Marks, kerning memberships and sticker-only cleanup use the metadata policy. Paths and components preserve image and sticker shapes unless separately chosen. Font-level guides stay.

title: Delete Stickers
copyright: 2017 in LICENSE.txt; 2018–2022 in README.md, Pedro Arilla
scope: Selected glyphs or whole font; all stored layers or master layers. Whole-font deletion requires Preview and default-No confirmation naming the font and glyph, layer and sticker counts, followed by a fresh plan check. Removes only ShapeSticker shapes under the metadata policy. Other shapes and notes stay. Automatic owners and locked layers are listed and kept.

title: Decompose Serif Components
copyright: 2017 in LICENSE.txt; 2018–2022 in README.md, Pedro Arilla
scope: Selected glyphs and chosen masters; case-sensitive Serif base-name prefix. Preview and shared one-level decomposition. Other components and own contours stay. Automatic layers and automatic dependants refuse.

title: Make Lower Unicase
copyright: 2017 in LICENSE.txt; 2018–2022 in README.md, Pedro Arilla; based on Georg Seifert's Make Unicase Font idea
scope: Existing uppercase cells on all masters. Canonical round-trip lowercase sources precede Unicode and glyph-name order. Later mappings, missing capitals, characters without a separate uppercase and multi-character uppercase mappings have distinct kept rows. Required Preview and default-No confirmation name the font and counts. Image and sticker shapes stay. Existing targets without a safe plain component to copy are kept; other eligible targets still change.

title: Set Default Figures
copyright: 2017 in LICENSE.txt; 2018–2022 in README.md, Pedro Arilla
scope: Choose .lf, .osf, .tf or .tosf sources for every master. Missing default digit cells are created with components and Unicode assignments through Add Glyph. Existing targets without a safe plain component to copy are kept. Replace own contours defaults on and can be disabled. Existing anchors, images, stickers and Unicode stay. Copies advances and kerning memberships. Rebuild consent releases eligible automatic-composite bases. Reports created names and automatic rebuild diagnostics; consented work continues.

title: Retract Handles
copyright: 2017 in LICENSE.txt; 2018–2022 in README.md, Pedro Arilla
scope: Selected glyphs and chosen masters. Retract all cubic handles or handles attached to selected on-curve indices from the current master. Matching master structures are required for mapped selection. Open ends do not wrap; quadratic, shared and transformed outlines stay.

title: Simplify Selected Nodes
copyright: 2017 in LICENSE.txt; 2018–2022 in README.md, Pedro Arilla
scope: Exact alternate-node removal from selected polygon indices, mapped from the current master onto compatible masters. Open endpoints stay; closed polygons retain at least three nodes. Curves stay; use FontLab Contour > Simplify for curve reduction.
